label: semantic DOM/SVG scene and exact frame-indexed preview renderer

commands.stdoutSummary: Vitest passed 1 file and 14 tests, including golden frames 0, 59, 70, and 119, unified scrub/playback/capture identity, local font path validation, manifest checking, and rejection/read-back/determinism checks.

assertions: renderFrame is pure and frame-indexed; repeated frame output is structurally identical.
DOM/SVG output preserves editable text and owner geometry metadata and rejects flattened image owners.
Local font readiness is required and remote font URLs are rejected.
Read-back metadata must equal the requested frame for scrub, playback, and capture.
Scrub, playback, and PNG capture all delegate to the same pure renderFrame source.
Local font paths must be non-empty local font files and can be proven with an injected manifest checker; paths are preserved in output metadata.
Unknown geometry references and forbidden wall-clock/random APIs are rejected/absent.
